caseName: Webster ex rel. Webster v. Perry
caseNameFull: Webster, a minor, by Webster v. Perry, Chairman, Board of Education of Winston-Salem/Forsyth County School System

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. W. D. N. C. Judgment vacated and case remanded to the District Court so that it may enter a fresh judgment from which a timely appeal may be taken to the Court of Appeals.
